plugins.name: sidebar
plugins.description: A live widget sidebar for Claude Code: model badge, context-window gauge, session cost, 5-hour / weekly usage dial, plus New chat, Commit & Push and Handoff buttons (from the commit-push and handoff mods).

plugins.name: commit-push
plugins.description: One-click Commit & Push: stages the active repo's changes, has Claude write a conventional commit message from the diff, commits and pushes (setting the upstream if needed). /commit-push, or the sidebar button.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: One-click handoff: asks Claude to write handoff.md, waits until it exists, runs /clear, then has the fresh chat read handoff.md and continue. /handoff, or the sidebar button.
